import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
        for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            if right - left > 1:
                for c in range(left + 1, right):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
file=p/'task-c16c9305.py'
file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(file), 'exec'), globals())
